name: Compass Cleaner
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: spekarchik
description: A simple mod that allows you to easily demagnetize compasses using a straightforward crafting recipe. Keeps your inventory organized by preventing confusion between magnetized and regular compasses.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
